3. What the build includes

Everything below is included at no charge for Jeff. Nothing here is an add-on or an upsell.

  • ✓
    Storefront design in their brandHome, shop, product, about, and contact pages, built for phones first since most apparel sales start there.
  • ✓
    Admin backendProducts, variants, inventory, orders, customers, discounts, and sales reporting, in the dashboard layout shown above.
  • ✓
    Product catalog loadingTheir launch products loaded with photos, prices, sizes, and colors. Count confirmed together in the pricing review.
  • ✓
    Cart and checkoutCard and wallet payments, order confirmation emails, and a checkout that works cleanly on a phone.
  • ✓
    Shipping and tax setupShipping zones and rates, local pickup if they want it, and sales tax settings for the states they sell into.
  • ✓
    Domain hookupTheir domain pointed at the new store, with secure checkout on their own address.
  • ✓
    Design questionnaire and logo cleanupIncluded at no extra charge, same as the Cake Factory package. Their rough logo, the one used all through this mockup, gets cleaned into crisp print ready files for shirts, the site, and socials.
  • ✓
    Walkthrough and handoffA live walkthrough of the backend before launch, plus a short written guide for adding a product and shipping an order.
